name: Core Data Structures
description: Choose the right data structure and turn slow nested loops into a single pass.

lessonNames.l3-two-sum: Two numbers that add to a target
lessonNames.l8-best-day: The best day to buy and sell
lessonNames.l18-order-book-heaps: An order book with two heaps

lessonObjectives.l1-arrays-in-memory: Explain why indexing is fast and inserting in the middle is slow.
lessonObjectives.l2-constant-time-lookup: Replace a nested loop with a hash map.
lessonObjectives.l3-two-sum: Solve two-sum in one pass with a hash map.
lessonObjectives.l4-frequencies: Solve anagram and frequency problems by counting.
lessonObjectives.l5-both-ends: Solve sorted-array problems with two pointers.
lessonObjectives.l6-sliding-window: Find the best subarray with a window that grows and shrinks.
lessonObjectives.l7-prefix-sums: Answer range-sum queries in constant time after one pass.
lessonObjectives.l8-best-day: Find the maximum profit from one trade in a single pass.
lessonObjectives.l9-last-in-first-out: Use a stack to check that brackets match.
lessonObjectives.l10-next-greater: Use a monotonic stack to find the next greater element.
lessonObjectives.l11-first-in-first-out: Use a queue and a double-ended queue.
lessonObjectives.l12-nodes-and-pointers: Traverse and reverse a linked list.
lessonObjectives.l13-fast-and-slow: Detect a cycle in a linked list with two pointers.
lessonObjectives.l14-binary-trees: Traverse a binary tree in pre-order, in-order and post-order.
lessonObjectives.l15-search-trees: Search and insert in a binary search tree.
lessonObjectives.l16-tree-recursion: Compute a tree’s depth and check its balance with recursion.
lessonObjectives.l17-always-the-smallest: Use a heap to keep the top $k$ items.
lessonObjectives.l18-order-book-heaps: Track the best bid and ask with two heaps.
